lines.text: So. The rain woke you, and Aaron woke your courage.
Listen well: the Hollow King took the Heartstone below the ridge, into the Sunken Crypt.
My adventuring days are done. Take my old blade from the chest.
Press X to swing it. Hold X to charge a spin. Z lifts things. ENTER rests and saves.
That blade's yours now. A sword's a promise - keep it sharp.
The Crypt's stair waits on the ridge north of the meadow. Bomb the cracked walls.
Green dust wakes the sleeping. It matters below - trust an old man.
The old signs down there still give true hints. Read them all.
If you meet a wizard who laughs at your sword... hit him with his own magic.
The Heartstone hums again, and the rain's gone. You've repaid us all, child.
